586-864-2034-3125-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2034-3125-7396.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius, History Chaser.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

413-2728-6854-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
413-2728-6854-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
413-2728-6854-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-6254-7811.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Iron Man triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton
Repeat.

676-1987-4863.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
676-1987-4863.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creature tokens.
676-1987-4863.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
676-1987-4863.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-2079-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-2079-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-2079-5457.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

2034-5003-5993.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Experimental Aviator, adding {C}{C}.
When Experimental Aviator dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Experimental Aviator from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Experimental Aviator enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

628-997-7215.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Gnarlbark Elm.
When Gnarlbark Elm dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

141-2921-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2921-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2921-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

1496-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1496-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1309-1692-2489-3732.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}{R}.
1309-1692-2489-3732.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 1 or greater that can attack and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1309-1692-2489-3732.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{R}.
Cast Relentless Assault by paying {2}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets with haste.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters, it triggers, returning Relentless Assault from your graveyard to your hand.
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Nature's Will triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Move to your next main phase and repeat from step 1.

339-677-5686-7060.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1486-1753-2957-7014.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing North Pole Patrol to become a Dwarf until end of turn
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Repeat from step 2
1486-1753-2957-7014.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

141-2562-6797.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Phantom Train abilities from step 5.

147-6797-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-6797-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

104-4186-6720.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-4186-6720.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3774-4013-4554-5902.description:
Activate Luxior's first equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Teferi.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Teferi, which enters the battlefield with ten loyalty counters due to Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing nine loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2457-5794-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating six 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

6323-6328.easyPrerequisites: Jumbo Cactuar does not have summoning sickness.
6323-6328.description:
Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Cast Soul's Grace by paying {1}{W}, targeting Jumbo Cactuar and causing you to gain 10,000 life.

1987-2493-4276-4477.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2493-4276-4477.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Archaeomancer and Greenwarden of Murasa enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2493-4276-4477.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1617-4753-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Clever Impersonator on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1617-4753-4831-4983-5358.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Clever Impersonator to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

1376-1909-4486.notablePrerequisites: Priest of Titania does not have summoning sickness.
1376-1909-4486.description:
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Priest of Titania.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Repeat.
1376-1909-4486.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

3259-3480-5734.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant.
3259-3480-5734.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

3875-4693-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight lands.
3875-4693-5720-5721.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers that many times, creating a Treasure token for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite Treasure tokens and/or Food tokens due to Tireless Provisioner's trigger.

1069-1947-4763.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts, one of which must be an Equipment.
1069-1947-4763.description:
Activate any Equipment you control's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Reckless Barbarian.
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Reckless Barbarian dies, Koll triggers, returning Reckless Barbarian from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Reckless Barbarian by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.

220-340-4067-4306.notablePrerequisites:
Nin does not have summoning sickness.
Your devotion to red is at least five.
220-340-4067-4306.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U} or {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Nin by paying {2}{U}{R} and tapping it, dealing 2 damage to Brash Taunter and causing you to draw two cards.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Activate Mind over Matter twice by discarding two cards, untapping Nin and Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

1322-2104-3982-5131.notablePrerequisites:
If Living Lore is in your graveyard, you have not played a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
An opponent is unable to block your creatures.
1322-2104-3982-5131.description:
Cast Living Lore from your hand or graveyard by paying {3}{U}.
Living Lore enters the battlefield, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard.
Move to your combat phase, and deal combat damage with Living Lore.
Living Lore triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and cast Temporal Manipulation from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

738-1778-4050-4733.description:
Sacrifice Memnite to Phyrexian Altar, adding one mana of any color.
Dictate of Erebos triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Memnite to your hand.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
